source_custody.hidden_changes: 50% unchanged, 50% A-B-A; initial sign balanced within each; B starts uniformly t9..18, A returns t22..35. All worlds generated independently of R71 scored source.
source_custody.selected_task: Reuse existing R70 exact physical actuator law and R71 model/rollout interfaces on NEW worlds; 40 selected interventions, 4 observed terminal dims, hidden law/phase/actuator state inaccessible to learned policy.
source_custody.offline_behavior_source: R70 public-time causal calibration fixed policy t0,16,32 on fresh FIT worlds; only its ACTUAL selected action/outcome teacher-forced history and public timestep are used for supervised training; no oracle hidden-state labels/actions/counterfactuals.
source_custody.holdout_first_use: Generate and score independent new HOLDOUT only after all 12 trained seed/arm/objective models are frozen; never train or tune on HOLDOUT or reinterpret R71 DEV results.

hypothesis: Under matched optimizer steps and source world budgets, optimizing factual supervised reference actions is learnable when sparse delayed action-return policy gradients are too noisy. A negative result indicates even this scripted behavior is not robustly learnable under the chosen capacity/training budget; neither direction proves native intelligence.

arms.negative_control: STRUCTURED_CAUSAL_MEMORY trained on within-episode circularly shifted factual teacher action labels (by +5 steps): preserves action frequencies and observational history while breaking correct action-time pairing.
arms.privileged_reference: R70_CALIBRATE_CAUSAL public-time fixed factual policy as performance ceiling reference only, NOT private hidden-law oracle.
arms.fixed_control: R70_NO_CALIBRATE_REACTIVE, same new source; cannot be weakened or removed.
arms.learned_policy_information: Each model sees public time, only actually selected past actions/outcomes; no actual hidden causal regime, private actuator alignment, future selected reward or unchosen outcome.
arms.parameter_count_and_state: Record all parameter counts, structured state 16 floats, GRU 16 floats, MLP no persistent floats; no claimed identical floating compute or training information between RL and teacher-forcing arms.

training.paired_FIT_draws_seed_formula: 24419999 + model_seed, same draws for RL/BC and 3 architectures at each optimizer step; action trajectories differ as policies act.
training.initialization: Same corresponding R71 model initialization per architecture/seed for both training methods; no warm-start from R71 original scored weights.
training.RL_loss: Frozen R71 REINFORCE normalized reward-to-go - per-time-step batch baseline, divide advantage by 8, entropy weight 0.005. All source exposures actual selected actions/outcomes.
training.BC_loss: Cross entropy on exactly the actually selected public-time actions of the fixed R70 reference, teacher-forced with its actually observed selected consequences only. No hidden-law ground-truth or optimal private action.
training.shuffled_negative_loss: Same BC cross entropy and world budget with +5 circular shift in action labels only. Factual teacher histories still unchanged. One structured arm per seed.
training.gradient_quality: Before first optimizer update, measure flattened true selected-return policy-gradient vectors from two independent fresh FIT8 batches per architecture/seed; report cosine similarity and norms. Diagnostic only; no post-hoc metric-based admission.
training.full_cost: Train seconds per architecture/method/seed, optimizer steps, selected action/outcome exposures, exact weights SHA and whole process duration; CPU only.

scoring.eligibility: Supervised BC outcomes are mechanism/training-signal diagnostics only; trained imitation is not reward-discovery or an independent causal learning improvement.
scoring.strong_controls: Full original qualified fixed R70 public-time causal calibration, fixed no-calibration reactive; fully trained GRU16 and MLP16 under both method objectives.
scoring.outcome_on_fail: DEV_DIAGNOSTIC_NO_GO; preserve result and no after-score tuning, do not infer cause from loss alone.
scoring.outcome_on_pass: DEV_SCRIPTED_BEHAVIOR_LEARNABILITY_SIGNAL_ONLY; improves controlled behavior cloning but DOES NOT establish learning new causal rules, trained agent scientific superiority, efficiency or AGI.
